dialogues.speaker: Araby
dialogues.text: The sages enjoy the highest status in Akademiya. There is one per school, six in all.

dialogues.speaker: Araby
dialogues.text: The sages assign jobs to us researchers.

dialogues.speaker: Araby
dialogues.text: Just like I was sent to monitor the ocean and watch the lighthouse.

dialogues.speaker: Araby
dialogues.text: It's basically a boring job when there's no sea creatures. The only positive side is its security.
